title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai Anime Debuts Part 2 on Netflix on June 18
content: The staff for BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai , the anime of Keisuke Itagaki 's first Baki-Dou manga, announced on Wednesday that its second part or cours (quarter of a year) will premiere exclusively worldwide on Netflix on June 18. All 12 episodes will be available at once.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Junji Ito Omnibus Series Announces Cast
content: TV Tokyo announced on Thursday the cast for Strange -Itō Junji no Yoru mo Nemurenu Kimyō na Hanashi- (Strange - Junji Ito 's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights), the live-action omnibus series based on 13 manga stories by Junji Ito .

title: George Wada Calls for a Japanese Anime Awards as Criticisms of Crunchyroll Anime Awards Return for Another Year
content: Production I.G and WIT Studio President George Wada has called for a Japanese anime awards in recent comments made at a conference on the sustainable development of Japan’s anime industry.

title: Sega Announces Sonic Live in Concert Global Tour
content: Sega announced on Wednesday the Sonic Live In Concert global tour for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, which will run in the U.S. and the U.K. from September 20, 2026-February 20, 2027. The company will announce other European stops at a later date.
author: ANN

content: Disney+ just brought back one of its long lost Disney animated shows to the streaming service after decades of being missing , and there are many others that still need to make their own comebacks.

title: Aloha Comics Adds Ikuno Tajima's Ever After Manga in English
content: Comic publisher Aloha Comics announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that it will release Ikuno Tajima 's After Märchen manga in English under the title Ever After as its first manga license. The company will release the two-volume series in hardcover copies with bonus merchandise.
author: ANN
